versions.changelog: The API key is now optional to load this skill; with no key, a pointer leads to a temporary free key with no signup and a link the user opens to keep it.
Documents the row fields, sector rollups versus the market-wide sector mood, sign handling for values that round to zero, and the quote delay fields.

Adds a scoped handoff to the dashboard skill for a full morning brief, and brings the tier and coupon wording in line with the rest of the collection; removes the npx execution path and declares permissions.

First release. One API call renders a self-contained interactive HTML treemap of the S&P 500, Nasdaq 100 or the popular list: every stock a tile sized by market cap, coloured by the day's move with a toggle to sentiment, SentiSense Score, mentions and options interest (PRO overlays), sector zoom, search, hover cards, keyboard reachable. Honest as-of labels, no reading is never drawn as zero. Works as a file, on any render surface, or pinned as an OpenClaw widget with no network grants.
